sections.title: 57.2 Scenario: Stale account balance
sections.body:
An agent retrieves a departmental budget of ₹5 lakh and caches it for one hour.

Ten minutes later, another system reserves ₹4 lakh.

The cached answer is no longer suitable for authorizing a ₹2 lakh transaction.

Stable descriptive information can often be cached safely within a defined freshness policy. Transaction preconditions require authoritative current checks.

diagram.title: Visual flow — 57.2 Scenario: Stale account balance

steps.label: Query
steps.narration: The user query enters the system and may need rewriting before search.

steps.label: Transform
steps.narration: Query transformation expands, rewrites, or decomposes the question to improve recall.

steps.label: Search
steps.narration: Dense and/or keyword search return candidate passages.

steps.label: Fuse
steps.narration: Fusion methods such as RRF combine rankings from multiple retrievers into one list.

steps.label: Rerank
steps.narration: A cross-encoder or LLM reranker reorders candidates for higher precision context.

steps.label: Context
steps.narration: Final context is budgeted, ordered, and injected into the prompt for grounded generation.

sections.title: 57.3 Cache key construction
sections.body:
```python
def tool_cache_key(
    tenant_id,
    authorization_version,
    tool_version,
    arguments_digest,
    data_version
):

    return (
        tenant_id,
        authorization_version,
        tool_version,
        arguments_digest,
        data_version
    )
```

A real implementation may also require user identity, field-level permissions, time constraints and purpose-specific access restrictions.

Do not cache a write operation as if it were a normal read response. A durable operation ledger and idempotency mechanism handle repeated logical writes.

sections.title: 57.4 Cache stampede protection
sections.body:
If 1,000 identical authorized lookup requests arrive immediately after a cache entry expires, ideally only one compatible computation should execute.

Use single-flight deduplication, bounded waiters, distributed coordination and TTL jitter.

Do not coalesce tasks across incompatible tenant or permission scopes.
